trickyParts: The Dispatch browser harness in this pod: Postgres 17 with pgvector, unpacked rootless from five Debian packages onto the issue volume at /legion/harness (setup.sh, env.sh; postgres on 127.0.0.1:54329, database dispatch_impl_e2e). Source /legion/harness/env.sh for the harness's own commands only. packages/contracts must be built (bun run build) or e2e/agents.ts fails to import @legion/contracts/dist, and packages/dispatch's own node_modules/.bin/playwright installs chromium, never bunx. Run --project=chromium: WebKit cannot launch in this pod.

packages/envoy/cmd/listener's tests need a Postgres: without DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL they panic 'rootless Docker not found' from testcontainers. With DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:54329/postgres?sslmode=disable and DISPATCH_TEST_NO_CONTAINERS=1 the package is green (502.9 s).
